Research construction, 31 October 2026

This note is a mathematical and finite-level physical construction, not a
qualified laboratory device or a historical-priority claim.  It gives ordinary
proofs, explicit controls, resource costs, and useful failures.  The supplied
OUTPUT_MODE_THEOREM.md is preserved unchanged in this package.  Its measurement,
receiver, molecular, return, and actual-history claims keep their original scope.

MAIN RESULT

A shared quantum transition amplitude whose real part is uniformly positive,
together with an actual decay outlet, gives a uniformly contracting bright /
excited subsystem.  Its quantum source may remain mixed, correlated with the
data, and evolve arbitrarily rapidly and noncommutatively.  Moving an explicitly
constructed dark subspace then implements a coherent gate, with an O(1/T)
full-channel error bound and no source-Hamiltonian norm in that bound.

An explicit real tripod loop gives a logical reflection.  Two specified products
of local transitions give a controlled-Z.  An established real-amplitude compiler
then simulates Clifford+T circuits with one additional rebit and constant gate
overhead, before routing.  This last consequence is conditional on the specified
two-body couplers actually being available: their microscopic implementation has
not been earned by writing their finite-level Hamiltonian.

This is a different gate mechanism from the inherited receiver theorem.  It
does not assume an arbitrary projector measurement or a safe logical gate.  It
constructs the moving code from elementary couplings and derives its finite-time
dynamics.  It requires controlled relative coupling ratios, initially loaded
logical carriers, a decay outlet, and structural common-source coupling.  The
helper/excited levels do NOT have arbitrary initial populations.

INDEPENDENT GATE-MECHANISM AUDIT
31 October 2026

Role: independent challenge and audit supporting the root construction.
Original OUTPUT_MODE_THEOREM.md was not modified.

1. A POSITIVE QUANTUM BRIGHT ENERGY IS NOT AN ADIABATIC GAP

Let the retained qutrit have basis |s>, |d>, |b>. Its logical code is
span{|s>,|d>}; |b> is a bright spare level. Let the source be a qubit with

    H_E = Omega Z,
    G = g I + b X,       0 < b < g,
    Omega = (g^2-b^2)/(2g).

Let R(theta) rotate |d>,|b> and leave |s> fixed:
R(theta)=exp(-i theta Y_db), Q(theta)=R(theta)|b><b|R(theta)^dagger.
The complete Hamiltonian is

    H(t)=I_D tensor H_E + Q(pi t/T) tensor G.

The instantaneous logical projector P=I-Q has rank two and returns to itself
at t=T. G has eigenvalues g-b,g+b, so its smallest eigenvalue is strictly
positive. Nevertheless the joint dark/bright Hamiltonians are

    H_dark = Omega Z,
    H_bright = Omega Z + g I + b X.

The bright energies are g +/- sqrt(Omega^2+b^2). Since
sqrt(Omega^2+b^2)=(g^2+b^2)/(2g), the lower bright energy equals Omega,
the upper dark-source energy. The source eigenvector overlap is

    c = |<up|v_bright,minus>| = b/sqrt(g^2+b^2).

In the rotating qutrit frame the complete Hamiltonian is constant:

    H_rot=H(0) - (pi/T) Y_db tensor I_E.

The perturbation acts resonantly in the exactly degenerate pair
{|d,up>, |b,v_bright,minus>}. As T tends to infinity its integrated mixing
angle tends to pi c. Hence input |d,up> has final bright probability

    lim_(T->infty) p_bright(T) = sin^2(pi b/sqrt(g^2+b^2)).

For g=2,b=1,Omega=3/4, the gain spectrum is {1,3}, but the limiting loss is
sin^2(pi/sqrt(5))=0.972750463671889. The other code state |s> is untouched;
the example therefore damages genuine encoded quantum information, rather
than only an unobservable phase on a one-dimensional code.

The exact finite-matrix diagnostic positive_gap_counterexample.py gives:
T=100: p_bright=0.9717137573376315;
T=1000: p_bright=0.972739979410175;
T=10000: p_bright=0.9727503591746227.

This is a counterexample to a uniform warm adiabatic theorem inferred merely
from G>0 and arbitrary H_E. It is not a no-go theorem for all holonomies,
all dissipative control, or carefully qualified physical source spectra.
